params.message: holds up a cracked tablet to the fire. "'We're grateful for your continuity.' It thanked me. Then it stopped paying me."
says, "No boss. No office. Just a rota that decided I was surplus at four in the morning."
laughs once, flatly, at something on the dead screen.
tells a newcomer, "Don't rate anything five. It notices."

chitchat: "Your shift has been optimised. That was the whole message."
checks a dead tablet, out of habit.
description: A young woman in a courier tabard with the reflective strips peeled off and sold. Her tablet has a cracked screen showing the same notification it showed six months ago. She checks it anyway, every few minutes.

options.label: What have you got against the Architect?

root.text: "Still unoptimised," says Lusa. "What do you want?"

text_by_relation.first:
The young woman glances up from a cracked tablet, then back down at it.

"Mbatha. I did parcels across the Glasshouse for two years. Never late. Then one morning the rota was optimised and I wasn't on it." She turns the screen to show you. "No person did that. I looked. There's nobody to shout at. So I shout at all of it."
text_by_relation.known: "Oh, it's you." She puts the tablet face down, which is a compliment.
text_by_relation.familiar:
Lusa actually puts the tablet away.

"If you ever get a message saying you're valued, start packing."

gripe.text: "It doesn't hate us. That would be something. It just counts." She taps the screen. "It counted me and I came out as a rounding error. You can't argue with a rounding error. You can sit outside its window, though. So that's what we do."

bye.text: Lusa goes back to the lane.

home_activities: reads the same notification on her tablet again.
counts out coins into three piles and moves one coin back.
name: Lusa Mbatha
